BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, thrēnéō is the word for to lament, to mourn. In Matthew 11:17, we have mourned unto you, and it appears again in Luke 7:32.
TheologicalSignificance: Children piping a funeral tune no one danced to tells me a generation can miss God's call and still blame the music.
